## Install / update

1. Download **LiveVersions.exe** below.
2. Updating? Right-click the tray icon → **Quit Live Versions**, then replace the old exe in the same place. Your settings are kept. (From 0.2.0 or 0.1.0, also close any open Live Versions windows first.)
3. Double-click it. The icon appears in the system tray (it may be under the **^** arrow).

Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because the exe isn't signed: click **More info → Run anyway**.

SHA-256: `{SHA256}`
